description: Create a test case in BrowserStack Test Management. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions.

case_type.description: Test case type (varies per project); omit for default.

custom_fields.description: Custom field NAME to value; array for multi-select.

folder_id.description: Folder id. If none, offer createProjectOrFolder.

host.description: Base URL of the issue tracker.

issues.description: Linked Jira/Asana/Azure issue IDs, as an array (not a JSON string).

priority.description: e.g. 'High', 'medium'; varies per project; default Medium.

project_identifier.description: Project id (PR-*). If none, offer createProjectOrFolder.

tags.description: Tags, as an array (not a JSON string).

template.description: 'test_case_steps' or 'test_case_bdd'; for a custom template use template_id.

step.description: Action to perform in this step.

name: createTestCase
